messages:
Aisha: heads-up: I'm planning a preview rollout for `flags.debounce.cohort_window_ms` on staging in ~15m. trying to smooth cohort churn during rapid config flips.
Tom: quick q: preview-only right? want to avoid any live lease changes.
Aisha: yes preview-only. runtime will evaluate new debounce logic and emit preview snapshots + diffs. no enforcement.
Ravi: please make preview apply async (return 202 + preview_id). earlier we had SDKs assuming sync 200 and caused accidental waits.
Megan: agreed. include `estimated_propagation_ms` and `affected_shards` in the 202 payload so Console can show progress and impact heatmap.
Aisha: plan: (1) run 2% cohort shadow for 2h (2) persist preview snapshot + sampled traces to S3 for 21d (3) run replay job to compute cost delta and leakage risk.
Tom: telemetry: avoid per-tenant labels. emit `debounce.preview_delta{cohort=\"c-9\"}` aggregated, plus a sampled event stream `debounce.preview_samples` at 1/200 for tenant-level evidence.
Ravi: for alerts use per-shard boolean gauge `debounce.preview_anomaly{shard=\"sh-01\"}` instead of tenant ids. also emit a sampled secure-log event with salted tenant_hash on anomaly.
Megan: Console UX asks: show a side-by-side aggregates table (p50/p95 request latency, denied_rate, lease_churn) and an "Inspect samples" drawer that opens redacted sampled events. ops requested an "Export evidence" button to zip snapshot+sampled traces+replay CSV.
Aisha: will add Export and wire it into the incident draft flow so oncall can attach to incidents quickly.
Tom: runbook: auto-pause preview if `debounce.preview_delta` > 2.5% absolute for any cohort OR if `debounce.preview_anomaly` fires 2x in 10m. auto-pause should create incident draft with preview_id and attach top 10 sampled events.
Ravi: add manual override rules: to resume after auto-pause requires 2-person ACK in Console; ACK records approver ids, preview_id, commit sha and returns an `audit_token`. `audit_token` required to resume or apply.
Megan: API note: add `/preview/{id}/status` with {state, estimated_propagation_ms, affected_shards, preview_size_estimate}. make sure SDK examples show handling 202 and polling.
Aisha: also adding a small deterministic replay job that replays sampled inputs for prev/new logic and emits CSV (cpu_ms, tokens, lease_ops_delta) consumed by Optimize. queue to run outside nightly ingestion windows.
Tom: sampling rate must be runtime-configurable and made available in Dedicated/Private builds. default 1/200 but ops may ramp to 1/50 for small cohorts.
Ravi: security: sampled tenant hashes must be salted + one-way hashed before emission and access gated. log retention for sampled events limited to 21d.
Megan: UX: when preview active show a compact timeline on the config page: start, any auto-pauses, manual ACKs, replay results link, and Export button. also a banner saying PREVIEW (not applied).
Aisha: adding diff bullets in the ACK modal: preview_id, git sha, human-friendly changes, replay CSV summary and runbook link. helps approvers.
ci-bot: preview-created by aisha/debounce-cohort  diff: 4 files changed  http://ci.redwood/internal/11011
Tom: please tag infra for metric names and shard labels so alerts are wired.
Ravi: and tag SDK owners for 202 behavior; we need clear examples.
Aisha: will open two PRs (runtime telemetry + preview API semantics) and link the runbook. launching preview at T+15.
Megan: thumbs-up. keep me on the PR for Console UI bits.
Aisha: launching in 12.
ci-bot: reminder  staging maintenance window starts in 3h  may affect replay scheduling.
Tom: ack. we'll queue replay after the maintenance window.
